_comment: Recorded perf baselines (PERF §5). Each entry: the pinned number, the release that measured it, and what regression looks like. All tests here run in the normal suite — there is no perf marker or tolerance flag (that harness was never built; the ratio-test table in PERF §5 is aspirational).

conftest_snapshot.note: T-9: conftest._BASELINE_MODS snapshot size. Growth past the budget means the per-test _restore() cost is drifting up — trim module state or split a module before adding more. Re-measured at 0.89.2 (turn split into turn_footer/tool_prefetch/argsalvage/turn_retry; 81 -> 85, prompt registry adds _prompts.py -> 86). Budget raised 86 -> 95 with ledger justification: the 0.88.x/0.89.x monolith decomposition (memory, compress, subagent, dispatch, turn) trades one _restore() scan over 5 fat module dicts for 17 small ones — same total entries (3560 vs 3023 at 0.68.0), +18% over five minor releases, and it is the direction the repo's stated convention (nx/_feature.py per concern) requires. Re-measured at 0.103.22: _project_tools.py adds the isolated manifest scanner, schema validator, and lazy handler loader; the entry budget rises 3900 -> 4300 to retain headroom for that focused module. Budget raised 95 -> 96 at 0.105.0: nx/_surfaces.py (steering queue + /tabs dashboard) adds one module with small module-level state (deque, two str slots) — +1 module, +58 entries. Budget raised 96 -> 97 at 0.114.0: nx/_platform.py (Windows-port primitives: locking, kill-tree, pid liveness) adds one module with small module-level state — +1 module, +~40 entries. Re-measured at 0.126.0 (97 modules / 4200 entries): the memory-drift stamping layer was deliberately folded into _memory_store.py rather than added as nx/_memory_drift.py because the budget was saturated at 97; budget raised 97 -> 100 (and entries 4300 -> 4500) to restore three modules of headroom so the next focused split doesn't force a same-commit ledger re-record. Budget raised 100 -> 102 at 0.135.0: nx/_render.py (UIUX_SPEC Phase B rendering vocabulary — panel/notice/kv_line/diff/stream_tail components plus the one box-glyph set) adds one module with table-only module-level state (two dicts, a glyph tuple) and carries no thread/timer/console of its own — +1 module, ~+30 entries. The second module of headroom restores the three-module cushion the 0.126.0 note intended.
